scientific_question: Can the fixed F71 query-blind current-memory candidate feature vector distinguish legal beneficial interventions from harmful and neutral alternatives on previously unexposed unregistered structural synthetics? This diagnoses representation sufficiency rather than fitting another policy.

method.observe: For every public event under the exact frozen F60 trajectory, enumerate every unique source-legal alternative retained state from ACTION.actions. No alternatives are injected into ongoing baseline trajectory.
method.offline_teacher: Apply unchanged F60 to remaining source public events separately for original F60 next state and each alternative; use current synthetic question offline ONLY to classify +1 beneficial, -1 harmful, 0 neutral.
method.visible_representation: F71's exact 12-dimensional features computed from before, frozen F60 next state, candidate next state and current public edge (no event index).
method.signature: Round each of the 12 normalized public features to 4 decimal places for deterministic, explicitly coarsened candidate-signature collision audit.
method.evidence: Report per-query-type and per-window sign counts; conflicting coarsened signatures where at least one beneficial and at least one harmful example share identical public feature signature; certify earliest beneficial oracle intervention's 72-prefix causal trace, at most one per case.
method.fairness: The offline future-question oracle is unfair and NONCOMPETITIVE; learned online mechanism never receives it, no new model trained.
method.selection: No trial selection or alteration of labels, bins, signature precision, or source after observing results.
